settings.name: OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRE_HOSTED_AGENT
settings.description: Whether an attested agent this authority does not host is refused (401); a hosted agent must be active and inside its notAfter whatever this says

when_wrong.detail: Anything but true, in any case, means false

settings.name: oidf.mock.attesters
settings.description: A JWKS file of attester keys trusted directly, with no federation trust chain: a development and demo hook. The image no longer sets it from a file in the build context; a development deployment mounts the file and sets the property itself

when_wrong.detail: A file that cannot be read is ignored; one that can is trusted, with a warning

settings.name: oidf.attestation.required.claims
settings.description: The top-level claims every client attestation must carry, comma-separated, for a client whose attestation_required_claims names none. The image set workload until 0.6.0; set OIDF_ATTESTATION_REQUIRED_CLAIMS=workload to keep that

when_wrong.detail: Read as given; a claim no attester sends refuses every such client
